name: tva-task-manager
description: Employee task management system (Progressive Web App)

scripts.autostart:enable: powershell -Command "$WshShell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell; $Shortcut = $WshShell.CreateShortcut((Join-Path ([System.Environment]::GetFolderPath('Startup')) 'TaskManager.lnk')); $Shortcut.TargetPath = 'powershell.exe'; $Shortcut.Arguments = '-NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \"' + (Join-Path (Get-Location) 'start-app.ps1') + '\"'; $Shortcut.WorkingDirectory = Get-Location; $Shortcut.Save()"
